title: AI infrastructure provider Infinigence AI raises RMB 2.3 billion in Series C funding
key_facts: Chinese company Infinigence AI completed a Series C round of RMB 2.3 billion, according to company materials provided on 12 Oct 2026.
Its cumulative financing is now RMB 4.3 billion; the company was founded in 2023.
It builds software and infrastructure that let AI models run efficiently across different chip platforms, including mixed training on Chinese and international processors.
Its platform links 37,000 petaflops of computing capacity across 16 mainstream chip types.
It also offers AI model inference services and infrastructure for enterprise AI agents, in gaming, healthcare, legal services and energy.
The company says daily token use on its model-service platform grew 40-fold by July compared with December 2025.
The company says its cross-cluster inference design cut the time to first token by 51.5% and cost per token by 37.5%.
quote_evidence: Chinese AI infrastructure provider Infinigence AI has completed a RMB 2.3 billion Series C funding round, bringing its cumulative financing to RMB 4.3 billion, according to company materials provided on October 12.
Infinigence AI said its model-service platform’s daily token usage had increased 40-fold by July compared with December 2025.
Its cross-cluster inference architecture reduced the time to generate the first token by 51.5% and cost per token by 37.5%, according to company figures.
why_it_matters_hint: More money for a Chinese company that lets AI run across many makers' chips, including Chinese and foreign processors.
notes: Short article based on company materials; investors are not named; the usage and efficiency figures are the company's own. Dealroom (headline only, not opened) puts the round at about $344 million.
